caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped, decorative box with a flat top and slightly curved sides. The box is primarily colored in soft beige and light brown tones, giving it an antique appearance. Both the lid and the sides of the box feature elaborate floral designs in various colors, including pink, blue, white, purple, and green. These floral arrangements are interspersed with ornate scrollwork and patterns in a muted cream or white color, bordered with reddish-brown lines. The edge of the lid is adorned with a repeating pattern of small, round yellow elements interspersed with green leaves and red accents, creating a decorative border. The background of the drawing is a plain, aged off-white paper with some faint staining or discoloration visible, and there is a small handwritten signature near the bottom right corner.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
